correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the four-state stationary forced-reversal Markov generator: rate lambda changes velocity sign and redraws positive magnitude uniformly from {c,cq}; finite-state Feynman–Kac eigenvalue s(k) near zero has simple real analytic even branch. Expansion of the exact rational spectral equation yields K2/t=c²(3q²-2q+3)/(4lambda) and K4/t=3c⁴(3q⁴+28q³-78q²+28q+3)/(16lambda³), with derivative-bounded O(1). I independently expanded the determinant of the 4x4 tilted generator and verified coefficient identities. P(q)/q²=3(q+1/q)²+28(q+1/q)-84 gives exactly one sign crossing at q≈1.847356; H'(q) factor gives one maximum at (7+2sqrt10)/3 and H=7/3. At the zero critical P, conclusion only leading coefficient vanishes and kurtosis O(t^-2); not strict sign at q_c.
